message:
fix: every discarded error is handled or explained (#112)

* fix(editor): a chain that will not write fails the read, not the file

editor.Document discarded SetSpec's error, so a model table naming a
parameter like a block attribute wrote a block with one of the two
lost. It is returned now, and a test reaches it through such a table.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(device): say why each discarded error on the device path is safe

A session's Close has no caller to report to and must release every
hold even when one refuses. Discovery's closes are cleanup beside the
error it returns, and encodeArg writes into a buffer that cannot fail.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(files): say why each discarded error on a file path is safe

Read-only closes, decompressor closes whose error the read already
returned, and cleanup of a temporary file beside the write error that
is returned. A device version the rig spells oddly is dropped, as the
rest of that section is.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(cmd): say why the help writes and required-flag marks go unchecked

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(device): trace what Close swallows, and say why darwin's releases may fail

Close has nobody to report a failed ack, channel close or release to,
so each now shows on the TONESTACK_USB_DEBUG trace in its own style.
With the trace off nothing changes. A test refuses every write and one
hold, turns the trace on and reads the lines back off stderr.

closeDevice and closeInterface get the best-effort comment the rest of
the sweep has.
